cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I copied the weather presenter's sun symbol. I said we'd come home glowing; that refund should do it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sun marks the studio. The island forecast was rain, and we've spent the holiday indoors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely, indoor warmth. I never said the glow had to come from a beach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ferry's bringing us home a day early. That's why we got the refund.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coming home glowing, word for word. I even put coming home before the glow.

reason: Replace unsupported confidence framing with a specific copied misconception that directs the Drive, retaining seed causality only where it remains understandable in the actual dialogue.
